flow.name: service-price-order
flow.doc:description: Simulated pricing service: POST /eip/services/pricing returns the order total (sum of quantity times unit price).

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: payload.orderId, total: sum(payload.items map ($.quantity * $.unitPrice)) }

flow.name: service-check-order-stock
flow.doc:description: Simulated stock service: POST /eip/services/stock says whether every item of the order is in stock, from synthetic stock levels.

flow.name: service-score-order-fraud
flow.doc:description: Simulated fraud service: POST /eip/services/fraud scores the order's customer; new customers (CUS-NEW...) are HIGH_RISK.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var score = if ((payload.customerId default "") startsWith "CUS-NEW") 80 else 10 --- { orderId: payload.orderId, customerId: payload.customerId, score: score, risk: if (score >= 70) "HIGH_RISK" else "LOW_RISK" }
